translations.literal: Music Thirteen
translations.idiomatic: Music Thirteen

translations.literal: (Music Section Seven)
translations.idiomatic: (Music Section Seven)

sentences.zh: ○朝會禦樓肆赦恭上皇帝皇太后尊號上建隆乾德朝會樂章二十八首皇帝升坐，《隆安》

translations.literal: ○ Court assemblies at the Imperial Tower, general amnesties, and respectful presentations of honorific titles for the emperor and empress dowager. Above: twenty-eight pieces of Jianlong and Qiande court-assembly music. When the emperor ascends to be seated—《Long'an》.
translations.idiomatic: ○ Court assemblies at the Imperial Tower, general amnesties, and the respectful bestowal of honorific titles upon the emperor and empress dowager. Above: twenty-eight pieces of Jianlong and Qiande court-assembly music. When the emperor takes his seat—《Long'an》.

translations.literal: Heaven draws near—brilliant; on high he patterns himself upon the Qian Origin.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven approaches in splendor; on high he takes the Qian Origin as his model.

translations.literal: Clangorous—the six musics; stern and reverent—a thousand officials.
translations.idiomatic: The six ensembles ring clear; a thousand officers stand grave and correct.

translations.literal: Imperial rites indeed solemn; the jade seat occupies the honored place.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial ceremony is duly solemn; upon the jade throne he holds the seat of honor.

translations.literal: Culture and brilliance are at the imperial carriage; ritual is prepared, sincerity endures.
translations.idiomatic: Civil brilliance attends the throne; rites stand complete and sincerity remains.

sentences.zh: 公卿入門，《正安》堯天協紀，舜日揚光。

translations.literal: Dukes and ministers enter the gate—《Zheng'an》—Yao's heaven accords with the registries; Shun's sun raises its light.
translations.idiomatic: As the ministers pass through the gate, 《Zheng'an》 plays: Yao's heavens keep the seasons; Shun's sun spreads its light.

translations.literal: Pure and careful your stopping; follow along the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Be pure and careful in your conduct; follow the established statutes.

translations.literal: Pendant rings abundant; metal and stone sound clear.
translations.idiomatic: Jade pendants chime in profusion; bells and stones ring clear.

translations.literal: Majestic bearing burns bright; supreme virtue is proclaimed abroad.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn bearing shines forth; supreme virtue is made manifest.

sentences.zh: 上壽，《禧安》乾健為君，坤柔曰臣。

translations.literal: Toast to longevity—《Xi'an》—Qian strength is the ruler; Kun softness is called the minister.
translations.idiomatic: Offering longevity—《Xi'an》: Qian strength makes the ruler; Kun softness names the minister.

translations.literal: Only such ministers and sons can serve lord and parent.
translations.idiomatic: Only such ministers and sons can serve their lord and parent.

translations.literal: Forever guarding the royal pole; thereby pacifying the myriad people.
translations.idiomatic: Forever guarding the royal pole, thereby bringing peace to the myriad people.

translations.literal: Raising cups to offer longevity; mountains and peaks tower rugged.
translations.idiomatic: They raise cups and offer long life; mountains stand rugged as peaks.

translations.literal: Shun's 《Shao》 plays again; Yao's wine floats on raised cups.
translations.idiomatic: Shun's 《Shao》 is played once more; Yao's wine floats in the goblets.

translations.literal: Imperial feelings are fully pleased; vast span has no bound.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's heart is wholly pleased; his great span knows no limit.

translations.literal: Foundation lofty at Jia and Fu; virtue abundant like Tang of Pottery.
translations.idiomatic: His foundation rises high as Jia and Fu; his virtue flourishes like the Pottery Tang.

translations.literal: Mountains lofty, sun bright; earth long-lasting, heaven long.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains tower, the sun blazes; earth endures, heaven lasts forever.

sentences.zh: 皇帝舉酒，第一盞用《白龜》聖德昭宣，神龜出焉。

translations.literal: The emperor raises his wine; the first cup uses 《White Tortoise》—sagely virtue proclaimed abroad, the divine tortoise appears.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor raises his wine; for the first cup they use 《White Tortoise》: sagely virtue is proclaimed abroad, and the divine tortoise appears.

translations.literal: Bearing the white of its color, sometimes roaming in streams.
translations.idiomatic: It bears the white of its hue, sometimes roaming in rivers.

translations.literal: Its name matches "in the marsh"; auspicious response—nesting on lotus.
translations.idiomatic: Its name accords with "in the marsh"; as an omen it nests upon lotus.

translations.literal: Ascending to sing upon the cinnabar steps; recording the wondrous in spiritual chapters.
translations.idiomatic: They ascend to sing upon the cinnabar steps and inscribe the marvel in sacred annals.

sentences.zh: 第二盞，《甘露》天德冥應，仁澤載濡。

translations.literal: Second cup—《Sweet Dew》—Heaven's virtue responds in obscurity; humane favor saturates and moistens.
translations.idiomatic: For the second cup, 《Sweet Dew》: Heaven's virtue responds in the hidden realm; humane grace saturates and moistens.

translations.literal: Its sweetness like ale; its congealing like pearls.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet as fine ale, it congeals like pearls.

translations.literal: Cloud-tops secretly knit; bright effulgence truly spreads.
translations.idiomatic: It forms secretly atop the clouds; bright glory is truly spread abroad.

translations.literal: Descending upon bamboo and cypress; forever proclaiming the auspicious chart.
translations.idiomatic: It falls upon bamboo and cypress, forever proclaiming the chart of omens.

sentences.zh: 第三盞，《紫芝》煌煌茂英，不根而生。

translations.literal: Third cup—《Purple Lingzhi》—brilliant brilliant, lush sprouts; without root it grows.
translations.idiomatic: For the third cup, 《Purple Lingzhi》: radiant and lush, it springs forth without roots.

translations.literal: Rush down steals color; the bronze pool records its fame.
translations.idiomatic: Even rush down loses its color; the bronze pool records its renown.

translations.literal: At dawn its spread displays the wondrous; three blooms divide their glory.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn its spread shows the marvel; three blooms share their splendor.

translations.literal: Written in the sagely archives; it illuminates our civil brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: It is written in the sagely archives, brightening our civilization.

translations.literal: Fourth cup—《Auspicious Grain》
translations.idiomatic: For the fourth cup, 《Auspicious Grain》.

translations.literal: How excellent those joined ears—presenting tribute in ascending peace.
translations.idiomatic: How fine those ears grown together—tribute offered in an age of peace.

translations.literal: Wondrous mark in the southern fields; auspicious response in western ripening.
translations.idiomatic: A marvel marked in the southern fields; an omen answered in the western harvest.

translations.literal: Virtue reaches to earth; the Imperial Earth Spirit manifests efficacy.
translations.idiomatic: When virtue reaches the earth, the Imperial Earth Spirit shows its power.

translations.literal: Images of harmony united; brilliant issuance in the auspicious classic.
translations.idiomatic: Signs of harmony joined; a radiant chapter in the book of omens.

sentences.zh: 第五盞，《玉兔》盛德好生，網開三面。

translations.literal: Fifth cup—《Jade Rabbit》—abundant virtue cherishes life; the net opens on three sides.
translations.idiomatic: For the fifth cup, 《Jade Rabbit》: abundant virtue cherishes life; the hunting net is opened on three sides.

translations.literal: Clear vision marks the marvel; prosperous times—then it is seen.
translations.idiomatic: Its clear gaze marks the wonder; in flourishing times it appears.

translations.literal: Nurturing substance in the snowy garden; sinking essence in the moon palace.
translations.idiomatic: It nurtures its form in the snowy garden and refines its essence in the moon palace.

translations.literal: Recorded in the music chapters; its color holds the river's silk.
translations.idiomatic: Recorded in the music chapters, its hue holds the sheen of river silk.

sentences.zh: 群臣舉酒，《正安》戶牖嚴丹扆，鵷鸞造紫庭。

translations.literal: The multitude of ministers raise wine—《Zheng'an》—doors and windows solemn before the vermillion screen; yuanluan birds come to the purple court.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers raise their wine—《Zheng'an》: doors and windows stand solemn before the vermillion screen; court birds come to the purple hall.

sentences.zh: 懇祈南嶽壽，勢拱北辰星。

translations.literal: Earnestly pray for the Southern Marchmount's longevity; bearing arches toward the North Pole star.
translations.idiomatic: They earnestly pray for the Southern Marchmount's long life; all bow toward the North Star.

sentences.zh: 得士於茲盛，基邦固以寧。

translations.literal: Gaining scholars here is abundant; founding the state firm thereby tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Here men of talent gather in abundance; the founding of the state is thereby secure.

sentences.zh: 誠明一何至，金石與丹青。

translations.literal: Sincerity and clarity—how extreme! Metal, stone, and cinnabar green.
translations.idiomatic: How perfect their sincerity and clarity—worthy of metal, stone, and painted record.

sentences.zh: 簪紱若雲屯，晨趨閶闔門。

translations.literal: Rank and ribbon like clouds assembled; in the morning they hasten to the Gate of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Caps and ribbons gather like clouds; at dawn they hurry to the Gate of Heaven.

translations.literal: Numerous numerous they array like Yu's assembly; abundant abundant they offer Yao's goblets.
translations.idiomatic: Countless as Yu's gathering they stand; in full array they raise Yao's goblets.

sentences.zh: 周禮觀明備，天儀仰晬溫。

translations.literal: Zhou rites show enlightenment complete; heavenly rites look up to brilliant warmth.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou ritual displays enlightenment complete; heavenly ceremony gazes upon radiant warmth.

sentences.zh: 高卑陳表著，同拱帝王尊。

translations.literal: High and low display rank; together they bow to the emperor's majesty.
translations.idiomatic: High and low show their stations; together they bow to the emperor's majesty.

sentences.zh: 待漏造王庭，威儀盛莫京。

translations.literal: Awaiting the clepsydra they proceed to the royal court; majestic bearing most glorious of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Waiting for the water clock, they enter the royal court; no ceremony in the capital is more grand.

sentences.zh: 紛綸簪組列，清越佩環聲。

translations.literal: Diverse diverse rank and ribbons arrayed; clear and piercing—pendant rings sound.
translations.idiomatic: Rank upon rank of ribbons arrayed; clear and piercing ring the jade pendants.

sentences.zh: 禮飲終三爵，《韶》音畢九成。

translations.literal: Rite-drinking ends with three toasts; 《Shao》 music completes the nine-fold.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual drinking ends with three toasts; the 《Shao》 music completes the nine movements.

sentences.zh: 永同鳧藻樂，千載奉升平。

translations.literal: Forever together with duckweed joy; a thousand ages serving ascending peace.
translations.idiomatic: Forever sharing the joy of duckweed and algae; for a thousand years they serve enduring peace.

sentences.zh: 群臣第一盞畢，作《玄德升聞》治定資神武，功成顯睿文。

translations.literal: When the ministers' first cup is finished, perform 《Mysterious Virtue Ascends to Hearing》—order settled draws on divine martial; achievement complete displays sagely culture.
translations.idiomatic: When the ministers finish their first cup, they perform 《Mysterious Virtue Ascends to Hearing》: order settled draws on divine martial power; success complete reveals sagely culture.

sentences.zh: 貢輸庭實旅，朝會羽儀分。

translations.literal: Tribute conveyed, court provisions travel; court assembly—feather regalia divides.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute is brought in and court stores are filled; at the assembly the feather regalia takes its stations.

sentences.zh: 偃革千年運，垂衣萬乘君。

translations.literal: Laying aside weapons—a thousand-year fortune; draping robes—the ten-thousand-chariot lord.
translations.idiomatic: Weapons are laid aside for a thousand-year fortune; he drapes his robes—the lord of ten thousand chariots.

sentences.zh: 孰知堯、舜力，明德自升聞。

translations.literal: Who knows Yao and Shun's strength? Bright virtue itself ascends to hearing.
translations.idiomatic: Who can know the power of Yao and Shun? Bright virtue itself rises to be heard.

sentences.zh: 約法皇綱正，崇文寶曆昌。

translations.literal: Summarized law—the imperial net is correct; honoring culture—the treasure calendar flourishes.
translations.idiomatic: The summarized law sets the imperial net aright; culture is honored and the precious calendar flourishes.

sentences.zh: 遒人振木鐸，農器鑄幹將。

translations.literal: Courier men shake wooden clappers; farm implements are cast from Ganjiang steel.
translations.idiomatic: Heralds shake wooden clappers; farm tools are cast from Ganjiang iron.

sentences.zh: 瑞日含王宇，卿雲藹帝鄉。

translations.literal: Auspicious sun contains the imperial chamber; ministerial clouds lush over the emperor's homeland.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious sun embraces the royal house; ministerial clouds billow over the emperor's domain.

sentences.zh: 萬邦成一統，鴻祚與天長。

translations.literal: Ten thousand states become one unity; great blessing with heaven long.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand states are united as one; great fortune endures as long as heaven.

sentences.zh: 六變宸扆威容盛，聲明禮樂宣。

translations.literal: Six changes—the imperial screen's majestic bearing abundant; fame declared, ritual music proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Six changes: the imperial screen's majesty overflows; fame is declared and ritual music proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 九州臻禹會，萬國戴堯天。

translations.literal: Nine regions attain Yu's assembly; ten thousand states wear Yao's heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The nine regions gather as at Yu's assembly; ten thousand states bear Yao's heaven.

translations.literal: Tribute duties submit precious gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute offices present precious gifts.

translations.literal: Imperial designs illuminate bamboo slips.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial plans brighten the bamboo annals.

sentences.zh: 含和均暢茂，鴻慶結非禋。

translations.literal: Harmony blended, even and abundant flourishing; great celebrations conclude—not a Yin sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Harmony is blended, ease and abundance flourish; great blessings gather—not by sacrifice alone.

sentences.zh: 朝會儼威儀，司常建九旗。

translations.literal: Court assembly—majestic bearing solemn; the Director of Constants raises nine banners.
translations.idiomatic: At court assembly bearing stands solemn; the Director of Constants raises nine banners.

sentences.zh: 舞容分綴兆，文物辨威蕤。

translations.literal: Dance forms divide string arrangements; cultural objects distinguish majesty's flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Dance patterns divide the string arrangements; ritual objects mark the splendor of majesty.

sentences.zh: 運格桃林牧，祥開洛水龜。

translations.literal: Fortune's pattern—the Peach Grove herdsman; auspicious opening—the Luo River tortoise.
translations.idiomatic: Fortune matches the herdsman of Peach Grove; auspicious signs open with the Luo tortoise.

sentences.zh: 帝功潛日用，化俗自登熙。

translations.literal: Imperial merit secretly employed day by day; transforming customs themselves ascend to brightness.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial merit works day by day in secret; customs are transformed and rise to brightness.

sentences.zh: 螭階聊載筆，紀瑞軼唐、虞。

translations.literal: At the dragon steps for a time he records with brush; recording auspicious signs surpasses Tang and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: For a time at the dragon steps he records with his brush; omens recorded surpass Tang and Yu.

sentences.zh: 丹鳳儀金奏，黃龍負寶圖。

translations.literal: Cinnabar phoenix marks the golden performance; yellow dragon bears the treasure chart.
translations.idiomatic: The cinnabar phoenix marks the golden music; the yellow dragon bears the treasure chart.

sentences.zh: 群材薪棫樸，仁政煦蒲盧。

translations.literal: Multitude of materials fuel chop-wood stacks; humane government warms pupa-fish.
translations.idiomatic: Talents are gathered like fuel for the chop-wood; humane rule warms even the pupa-fish.

sentences.zh: 蕩蕩巍巍德，豚魚信自孚。

translations.literal: Vast vast, lofty lofty virtue; pig and fish truly themselves trust.
translations.idiomatic: Vast and lofty is his virtue; even pig and fish truly trust in him.

sentences.zh: 接聖宅神都，方來五達區。

translations.literal: Connecting to sageliness, dwelling in the divine capital; from all sides come the five thoroughfares.
translations.idiomatic: Joined to the sage, he dwells in the divine capital; from every quarter the five roads converge.

sentences.zh: 國賢熙帝載，靈命握乾符。

translations.literal: State worthies glorify the emperor's record; spiritual mandate grasps the Heavenly tally.
translations.idiomatic: Worthies of the realm glorify the imperial record; the spiritual mandate holds the Heavenly tally.

sentences.zh: 至化當純被，斯文益誕敷。

translations.literal: Ultimate transformation should purely cover; this culture increasingly spreads vast.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme transformation should purely enfold all; this culture spreads ever more widely.

sentences.zh: 車書今混一，聖治奉三無。

translations.literal: Carriages and writing today mixed as one; sagely governance upholds the Three Non-Actions.
translations.idiomatic: Today chariots and script are united as one; sagely rule upholds the Three Non-Actions.

sentences.zh: 聖皇臨大寶，八表湊才賢。

translations.literal: Sagely emperor faces the great treasure; eight regions gather worthies.
translations.idiomatic: The sage emperor faces the great treasure; from the eight directions worthies assemble.

sentences.zh: 經緯文天賦，剛柔德日宣。

translations.literal: Warp and woof—the pattern of heaven conferred; rigidity and softness—virtue daily proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Warp and woof—the pattern heaven bestowed; firm and yielding—his virtue is daily proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 建邦隆柱石，造物運陶甄。

translations.literal: Founding the state elevates pillar-stones; the creator's transforming work turns the pottery wheel.
translations.idiomatic: To found the state he raises pillar-stones; the Creator's transforming work turns the potter's wheel.

sentences.zh: 共致升平業，綿長保億年。

translations.literal: Together they bring ascending peace's enterprise; continuously long, preserving a hundred million years.
translations.idiomatic: Together they achieve the work of enduring peace; continuously they preserve a hundred million years.

sentences.zh: 神化妙無方，巍巍邁百王。

translations.literal: Divine transformation subtle without direction; lofty lofty—surpassing a hundred kings.
translations.idiomatic: Divine transformation is subtle beyond reckoning; lofty and high—he surpasses a hundred kings.

sentences.zh: 鶴書搜隱逸，龍陛策賢良。

translations.literal: Crane letters search out hidden recluse; dragon steps strategize worthy men.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial summons seek hidden worthies; at the dragon steps he tests able men.

sentences.zh: 拱揖朝群後，賓筵辟四方。

translations.literal: Bowing in yielding toward the host of lords behind; guest feasts open to the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: He bows and yields to the host of lords; guest feasts open to the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 洪圖基億載，淳曜德彌光。

translations.literal: Grand design foundations a hundred million ages; pure radiance—virtue increasingly bright.
translations.idiomatic: His grand design foundations a hundred million ages; pure radiance—his virtue grows ever brighter.

sentences.zh: 第二盞畢，《天下大定》皇猷敷八表，武誼肅三邊。

translations.literal: Second cup finished—《Under Heaven Greatly Settled》—imperial designs spread to eight quarters; martial righteousness is stern on three marches.
translations.idiomatic: When the second cup is finished—《Under Heaven Greatly Settled》: imperial designs spread to the eight directions; martial righteousness secures the three frontiers.

sentences.zh: 蘭錡韜兵日，靈台偃伯年。

translations.literal: Spear-mat shield chariots sheathe weapons' day; Spirit Tower lies down lances' year.
translations.idiomatic: Days when spear-shields are sheathed; years when the Spirit Tower lays by its weapons.

sentences.zh: 奉珍皆述職，削衽盡朝天。

translations.literal: Presenting treasures—all describe duties; cutting lapels—all pay court to heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting treasures—all fulfill their duties; laying aside barbarian dress—all attend court.

sentences.zh: 功德超前古，音徽播管弦。

translations.literal: Meritorious virtue surpasses former antiquity; sound and emblem spread through pipes and strings.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious virtue surpasses the former ancients; fame spreads through pipes and strings.

sentences.zh: 伐叛天威震，恢疆帝業多。

translations.literal: Punishing rebels—heaven's might quakes; restoring borders—imperial enterprise many.
translations.idiomatic: Punishing rebels—heaven's might thunders; restoring the borders—the imperial enterprise grows vast.

sentences.zh: 削平侔肅殺，涵煦極陽和。

translations.literal: Cutting down and pacifying equals solemn killing; saturating warmth—utmost yang harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Conquest and pacification match stern execution; nurturing warmth—utmost harmony of yang.

sentences.zh: 蹈厲觀周舞，風雲入漢歌。

translations.literal: Stomping vigorous, viewing Zhou dance; wind and clouds enter Han song.
translations.idiomatic: Stomping boldly they watch Zhou dance; wind and clouds enter the Han song.

sentences.zh: 功成推大定，歸馬偃周戈。

translations.literal: Merit accomplished extends great settlement; returning horses lay down Zhou halberds.
translations.idiomatic: When merit is complete, great settlement is proclaimed; horses are returned and Zhou halberds laid aside.

sentences.zh: 六變惕厲日乾乾，潛蟠或躍淵。

translations.literal: Six changes—caution and vigor, days dry dry; lurking coiled or leaping in the deep.
translations.idiomatic: Six changes: vigilant and vigorous, days upon days; coiled in the deep or leaping from the abyss.

sentences.zh: 伐謀參上策，受鉞總中堅。

translations.literal: War stratagems participate in upper plans; receiving axes commands the central firm.
translations.idiomatic: War stratagems inform the highest plans; receiving the battle-axe he commands the central host.

sentences.zh: 田訟歸周日，民謠戴舜年。

translations.literal: Field lawsuits return to Zhou's day; folk songs wear Shun's year.
translations.idiomatic: Field disputes return to Zhou's age; folk songs celebrate Shun's years.

sentences.zh: 風雲自冥感，嘉會翼飛天。

translations.literal: Wind and clouds from themselves darkly move; fine meetings wing-fly to heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Wind and clouds stir of themselves in the hidden realm; glorious gatherings wing their way to heaven.

sentences.zh: 壺關方逆命，投袂起親征。

translations.literal: Pot Pass presently rebels against the mandate; fling sleeves and rise to personal campaign.
translations.idiomatic: At Pot Pass they presently rebel against the mandate; he flings back his sleeves and leads the campaign in person.

sentences.zh: 虎旅聊攻伐，梟巢遽蕩平。

translations.literal: Tiger hosts for a time attack; owl nest swiftly swept level.
translations.idiomatic: Tiger troops for a time attack; the owl's nest is swiftly swept away.

sentences.zh: 天威清朔漠，仁澤被黎氓。

translations.literal: Heaven's might clears the northern desert; benevolent bounty covers the black-haired people.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's might sweeps the northern wastes clean; merciful grace covers the people.

sentences.zh: 按節皇輿復，洋洋載頌聲。

translations.literal: Following the beat, the imperial carriage returns; vast, vast bearing sounds of praise.
translations.idiomatic: To the measured beat the imperial carriage returns, bearing vast songs of praise.

sentences.zh: 蠢茲淮海帥，保據毒黎苗，不悟龍興漢，猶同犬吠堯。

translations.literal: Stupid are these Huaihai commanders, holding fast and poisoning the black-haired folk; they do not perceive Han's dragon rise, still like dogs barking at Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Foolish are these Huaihai commanders, entrenched and venomous among the people; they fail to see Han's dragon arise, yet bark at Yao like dogs.

sentences.zh: 六師方雨施，孤壘自冰消。

translations.literal: Six armies just now spread like rain; lone ramparts by themselves melt like ice.
translations.idiomatic: The six armies spread like timely rain; lone strongholds melt away like ice.

sentences.zh: 千載逢嘉運，華夷奉聖朝。

translations.literal: A thousand years meet a fine fortune; Chinese and barbarians serve the holy court.
translations.idiomatic: After a thousand years they meet a glorious age; Chinese and barbarians alike submit to the holy court.

sentences.zh: 上遊荊楚要，澤國洞庭深。

translations.literal: Above he tours Jing-Chu keys; marsh country—Dongting is deep.
translations.idiomatic: He tours the vital points of Jing and Chu; in the waterlands Dongting runs deep.

sentences.zh: 自識同文世，皆回拱極心。

translations.literal: Each knows the age of shared script; all turn to bow toward the pole.
translations.idiomatic: They know themselves in an age of unified culture; all turn their hearts toward the pole.

sentences.zh: 一戎聊杖鉞，九土盡輸金。

translations.literal: One campaign for a time—staff battle-axes; nine lands all offer gold.
translations.idiomatic: With one campaign he briefly takes up the battle-axe; the nine regions all present tribute.

sentences.zh: 大定功成後，薰風入舜琴。

translations.literal: Great settlement merit accomplished after; balmy wind enters Shun's qin.
translations.idiomatic: When great settlement is complete, the balmy breeze enters Shun's zither.

sentences.zh: 席卷定巴、邛，西遐盡率從。

translations.literal: Rolled mat settles Ba and Qiong; western distance all lead in submission.
translations.idiomatic: Like a rolling mat he settles Ba and Qiong; the far west all submits of itself.

sentences.zh: 岷、峨難負阻，江、漢自朝宗。

translations.literal: Min and E difficult to bear against; Jiang and Han themselves court the ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Min and E cannot long resist; the Yangtze and Han turn of themselves toward court.

sentences.zh: 述職方舟集，驅車九折通。

translations.literal: Describing duties—square boats gather; driving chariots—the nine bends pass through.
translations.idiomatic: They come to report their duties in fleets of boats; chariots pass the nine bends.

sentences.zh: 粲然書國史，冠古耀豐功。

translations.literal: Brilliantly written in state history; crowning antiquity, brilliant abundant merit.
translations.idiomatic: Brilliantly recorded in the state annals, surpassing the ancients in glorious achievement.

sentences.zh: 銳旅慶回旋，邊防盡晏然。

translations.literal: Sharp hosts celebrate circling return; border defense all calm and still.
translations.idiomatic: The keen troops celebrate their triumphant return; the borders are wholly at peace.

sentences.zh: 鍵櫜方偃武，飛將亦韜弦。

translations.literal: Keys and quivers just now lay down arms; flying generals also hide bowstrings.
translations.idiomatic: Keys and quivers are laid aside as arms rest; flying generals too sheathe their bows.

sentences.zh: 震曜資平壘，文明協麗天。

translations.literal: Quake and brilliance aid level ramparts; culture and brightness accord with beautiful heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Thunder and glory secure the pacified camps; civil splendor harmonizes with radiant heaven.

sentences.zh: 洸洸成大業，赫奕在青編。

translations.literal: Vast vast they achieve great enterprise; splendid and bright in green bamboo records.
translations.idiomatic: Grandly they accomplish the great work, splendid forever in the written records.

sentences.zh: 淳化中朝會二十三首上壽，《和安》四序伊始，三陽肇開。

translations.literal: Chunhua mid-court assembly twenty-three pieces—toast longevity—《He'an》—four seasons just begin, three yang first open.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-three pieces for the Chunhua mid-court assembly: offering longevity—《He'an》: the four seasons begin; the three yang forces first unfold.

translations.literal: Twig-wind enters the pitch-pipes; jade pitch-tubes fly ash.
translations.idiomatic: The spring wind enters the pitch-pipes; ash flies from the jade pitch-tubes.

translations.literal: Gazing at clouds, solemn audience; chiming pendants—they come.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the clouds they come in solemn audience; jade pendants chime as they approach.

translations.literal: Raising cups to offer longevity; gazing and bowing, stars wheel back.
translations.idiomatic: They raise cups and offer long life; gazing upward they bow as the stars wheel home.

translations.literal: One yang responds to the season; ten thousand states share one script.
translations.idiomatic: The first yang answers to the season; ten thousand lands share one script.

translations.literal: Heaven's first month marks the node; Grand Scribe writes the clouds.
translations.idiomatic: The year's first month marks the season; the Grand Astrologer records the clouds.

translations.literal: Condensed tassels at the imperial carriage; arrayed ranks thereupon divide.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's robes hang still upon the throne; the ranks are arrayed in order.

translations.literal: Longevity cups thus presented; blessings celebrate the bright lord.
translations.idiomatic: Cups of longevity are presented; blessings celebrate the enlightened sovereign.

sentences.zh: 皇帝初舉酒，用《祥麟》聖皇禦寓，仁獸誕彰。

translations.literal: Emperor first raises wine, uses 《Xianglin》—sagely emperor's carriage dwelling, benevolent beast born and displayed.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor first raises his cup, 《Xianglin》 is played: the sage emperor holds the realm; the benevolent beast appears.

translations.literal: At the suburban march they travel and tribute; roaming at the suburban altar they present auspiciousness.
translations.idiomatic: In the suburbs they come bearing tribute; at the suburban altar they reveal auspicious signs.

translations.literal: Stars and asterisms are what it receives; grass and trees without harm.
translations.idiomatic: It receives its nature from the stars; grass and trees go unharmed.

translations.literal: Recording marvels in trusted history; ascending song in the Grand Constant.
translations.idiomatic: Wonders are recorded in trustworthy annals; songs rise in the Grand Music Office.

sentences.zh: 再舉酒，《丹鳳》九苞薦瑞，戴德膺仁。

translations.literal: Again raising wine—《Danfeng》—nine packages present auspiciousness, bearing virtue, receiving benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Again they raise their cups—《Danfeng》: nine-fold blessings bring good omens; bearing virtue, they receive benevolence.

translations.literal: Ornamented brush-wings thereupon soar; spirit-sound loads and vibrates.
translations.idiomatic: Its plumes rise in splendor; spirit-notes resound.

translations.literal: Not the time—then not seen; there is the Way—then it arrives.
translations.idiomatic: It does not appear untimely; where the Way prevails, it comes.

translations.literal: Descending to Qi, not a match; measured against Shun as neighbor.
translations.idiomatic: It descends as at Qi, beyond compare; in bearing it is neighbor to Shun.

sentences.zh: 三舉酒，《河清》沔彼涇瀆，澄明鑒如。

translations.literal: Third cup—《Heqing》—wide are those Jing and Du, clear bright mirror-like.
translations.idiomatic: Third cup—《Heqing》: the Jing and Du flow clear, bright as a mirror.

translations.literal: Clear responds to treasure fortune; light encompasses the imperial dwelling.
translations.idiomatic: Clarity answers the precious age; light embraces the imperial palace.

translations.literal: Deep divides—sunken jade disk; through and through seen swimming fish.
translations.idiomatic: The depths reveal the sunken disk; swimming fish are seen clear to the bottom.

translations.literal: Sage reign without limit; divine blessing vast and great.
translations.idiomatic: The sage reign knows no end; divine favor is vast indeed.

translations.literal: Fourth cup—《White Tortoise》
translations.idiomatic: Fourth cup—《White Tortoise》

translations.literal: Examine that spirit-creature; truly it illuminates the sage emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Consider that spiritual creature: it truly glorifies the sage emperor.

translations.literal: Floating stone can be trodden; nesting on lotus—it shines the more.
translations.idiomatic: It treads on floating stone; nesting on the lotus it shines the brighter.

translations.literal: Metal direction—correct color; scale-clan—special auspiciousness.
translations.idiomatic: In the west its color is true; among the scaled creatures it is a rare omen.

translations.literal: Trusted writings eternally shine; emperor virtue without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Trustworthy records shine forever; imperial virtue knows no bound.

sentences.zh: 五舉酒，《瑞麥》芃芃嘉麥，擢秀分岐。

translations.literal: Fifth cup—《Auspicious Wheat》—lush lush fine wheat, pluck splendor, divide branches.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth cup—《Auspicious Wheat》: lush fine grain, splendid ears branching apart.

translations.literal: Sweet dew evening sprinkles; kind wind morning blows.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet dew falls in the evening; a gracious breeze blows at dawn.

translations.literal: Good farmers report auspiciousness; orderly officials praise the marvel.
translations.idiomatic: Good farmers report the omen; diligent magistrates call it a wonder.

translations.literal: Return beauty to the hero lord; break off and tribute it.
translations.idiomatic: They ascribe the beauty to the enlightened lord, break off the ears and present them in tribute.

sentences.zh: 群臣初舉酒畢，作《化成天下》軒、昊方同德，成、康粗比肩。

translations.literal: Ministers first raising wine finished, perform 《Transforming and Completing All Under Heaven》—Xuan and Hao just now same virtue; Cheng and Kang roughly shoulder to shoulder.
translations.idiomatic: When the ministers finish their first cup, they perform 《Transforming and Completing All Under Heaven》: matching Xuan and Hao in virtue, rivaling Cheng and Kang.

sentences.zh: 素風惟普暢，皇道本無偏。

translations.literal: Plain wind only universally pervades; imperial Way fundamentally without partiality.
translations.idiomatic: Plain virtue spreads everywhere; the imperial Way was never partial.

sentences.zh: 陰魄重輪滿，陽精五色圓。

translations.literal: Yin soul—double wheel full; yang essences—five colors round.
translations.idiomatic: The yin orb fills its double wheel; the yang essence rounds in five colors.

sentences.zh: 要荒咸率服，卓越聖功全。

translations.literal: Border and waste all lead in submission; transcendent sage merit complete.
translations.idiomatic: The farthest wastes all submit; transcendent sage merit is whole.

sentences.zh: 聖德比陶唐，千年祚運昌。

translations.literal: Sage virtue compared to Tao Tang; thousand years—throne-fortune flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Sage virtue matches Yao of Tao Tang; a thousand years of fortune flourish.

sentences.zh: 茂功雖不宰，鴻業自無疆。

translations.literal: Abundant merit though not ruling; grand enterprise by itself without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Though abundant merit needs no forcing, the grand enterprise is boundless of itself.

sentences.zh: 極塞成清謐，齊民益阜康。

translations.literal: Utmost frontier becomes clear and quiet; common people more abundant and well.
translations.idiomatic: The farthest frontier grows peaceful; the people grow ever more prosperous.

sentences.zh: 文明同日月，遐邇仰輝光。

translations.literal: Culture and brightness same as sun and moon; far and near look up to brilliant light.
translations.idiomatic: Civil splendor equals sun and moon; far and near gaze upon its radiance.

sentences.zh: 六變蕩蕩無私世，巍巍至聖君。

translations.literal: Six changes—vast vast unselfish age; towering towering utmost sage lord.
translations.idiomatic: Six changes: an age vast and without partiality; a sage lord towering and supreme.

sentences.zh: 山河分國寶，日月耀人文。

translations.literal: Mountains and rivers divide state treasures; sun and moon illuminate human culture.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains and rivers apportion the land's treasures; sun and moon illumine human culture.

sentences.zh: 厭浥凝甘露，輪囷吐慶雲。

translations.literal: Saturated—condensed sweet dew; coiled coils spit celebratory clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet dew condenses in abundance; billowing clouds bring celebration.

sentences.zh: 正聲兼《大雅》，洋溢應南薰。

translations.literal: Correct sounds together with 《Daya》, overflow and respond to southern warmth.
translations.idiomatic: Correct tones join with the 《Great Odes》, overflowing in answer to the southern breeze.

sentences.zh: 鴻範合彝倫，調元四序均。

translations.literal: Great Plan accords with constant norms; tuning the origin—four seasons even.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Plan harmonizes the constants; adjusting the origin, the four seasons are balanced.

sentences.zh: 歲功天吏正，禦苑物華新。

translations.literal: Yearly harvest—heaven's clerk correct; imperial park—things splendor new.
translations.idiomatic: The year's harvest is duly assessed; in the imperial park all things bloom anew.

sentences.zh: 底貢陳方物，來賓列遠人。

translations.literal: Lower tribute displays regional things; coming guests array far people.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute from the realms displays regional goods; guests array the peoples from afar.

sentences.zh: 奉常呈九奏，嘉貺動穹旻。

translations.literal: Director of Ceremonies presents nine performances; fine bestowals move the vaulted heavens.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies presents the nine performances; gracious gifts stir the heavens.

sentences.zh: 大君隆至化，興運契千齡。

translations.literal: Great lord elevates utmost transformation; rising fortune matches a thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: The great lord exalts supreme transformation; a rising fortune matches a thousand years.

sentences.zh: 覲禮俄班瑞，夷賨盡實庭。

translations.literal: Audience rites shortly display auspicious things; barbarian tribute all fill the court.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the audience rites display auspicious signs; tribute from the barbarians fills the hall.

sentences.zh: 成文調露樂，奉聖拱辰星。

translations.literal: Accomplished culture attunes Dew Music; serving the sage, bowing toward the star of dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Culture perfected tunes the Dew Music; serving the sage, they bow toward the pole star.

sentences.zh: 舞佾方更進，朝陽上楚萍。

translations.literal: Dance rows just now advance further; morning sun rises on Chu duckweed.
translations.idiomatic: The dance rows advance anew; the morning sun rises on the duckweed of Chu.

sentences.zh: 禮樂昭王業，寰區致太平。

translations.literal: Ritual and music illuminate kingly enterprise; all within the bounds bring great peace.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual and music proclaim the royal work; the whole realm attains great peace.

sentences.zh: 革車停北狩，雲稼屢西成。

translations.literal: Leather chariots stop northern hunts; cloudy harvests repeatedly west-complete.
translations.idiomatic: War chariots cease the northern campaigns; harvest clouds repeatedly ripen in the west.

sentences.zh: 國有詳延詔，鄉聞講誦聲。

translations.literal: State has detailed extended edicts; villages hear lecture-recitation sounds.
translations.idiomatic: The state issues edicts of broad instruction; in the villages one hears lecturing and recitation.

sentences.zh: 日華融五色，遐邇仰文明。

translations.literal: Sun splendor melts five colors; far and near look up to culture and brightness.
translations.idiomatic: Solar splendor blends the five colors; far and near look up to civilization.

sentences.zh: 亭障戢干戈，人心浹太和。

translations.literal: Pavilion barriers sheathe spears and halberds; people's hearts soaked in great harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Border posts lay by spear and halberd; hearts are steeped in great harmony.

sentences.zh: 務農登寶穀，獵俊設雲羅。

translations.literal: Devoted to farming, ascend treasure grain; hunt the outstanding, set cloud nets.
translations.idiomatic: Farming is promoted and precious grain harvested; outstanding talent is sought with nets spread wide.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳書良史，祥麟載雅歌。

translations.literal: Phoenix ritual—write in good chronicle; auspicious unicorn carries refined song.
translations.idiomatic: The phoenix rite is written by worthy historians; the auspicious unicorn enters refined song.

sentences.zh: 嘉辰資宴喜，星拱弁峨峨。

translations.literal: Fine season supplies banquet joy; stars arch, caps lofty lofty.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious day supplies feasting and joy; stars bow around lofty caps.

sentences.zh: 冠古耀鴻徽，深仁及隱微。

translations.literal: Crowning antiquity, brilliant great insignia; deep benevolence reaches hidden and minute.
translations.idiomatic: Surpassing the ancients, great emblems shine; deep benevolence reaches even the hidden and small.

translations.literal: 《Ernans》, 《Jianghan》 chanted; nine performances—phoenix flies.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Two Souths》 and 《Jiang and Han》 are sung; in nine performances the phoenix flies.

sentences.zh: 設虡羅鍾律，盈庭列舞衣。

translations.literal: Set frame-drums and net bells and pitch-pipes; fill courtyard, array dance robes.
translations.idiomatic: Frame-drums, bells, and pitch-pipes are set out; the courtyard fills with rows of dance robes.

sentences.zh: 文明資厚德，怡懌兆民歸。

translations.literal: Culture and brightness draw on thick virtue; pleased and delighted—the myriad people return.
translations.idiomatic: Civil splendor draws on deep virtue; in joy the myriad people are drawn home.

translations.literal: Again raising wine finished—《Might Spreads Within the Seas》
translations.idiomatic: When the second cup is finished—《Might Spreads Within the Seas》

sentences.zh: 革輅征汾、晉，隳城比燎毛。

translations.literal: Leather-mounted chariots campaign in Fen and Jin; destroy ramparts like burning fur.
translations.idiomatic: Leather chariots campaign in Fen and Jin; cities fall like fur in the fire.

sentences.zh: 桓桓勖軍旅，將將禦英豪。

translations.literal: Vigorous vigorous—exhort the army hosts; generals generals—repel heroic champions.
translations.idiomatic: Bold and vigorous they urge on the armies; generals upon generals repel the heroes.

sentences.zh: 神武誠無敵，天威詎可逃。

translations.literal: Divine martial truly without rival; heaven's might—how could one escape?
translations.idiomatic: Divine martial prowess truly has no rival; heaven's might—who could flee it?

sentences.zh: 王師宣利澤，霈若沃春膏。

translations.literal: Royal army proclaims beneficial bounty; pouring like watering spring ointment.
translations.idiomatic: The royal army proclaims its gracious bounty, pouring like spring rain on the land.

sentences.zh: 振萬方明德，疾徐咸可觀。

translations.literal: Shake the myriad regions—bright virtue; fast and slow—all can be watched.
translations.idiomatic: Brilliance shakes the myriad regions; slow or fast, all may be witnessed.

sentences.zh: 鏗鏘動金奏，蹈厲總朱幹。

translations.literal: Clangorous clangorous move metal performances; stomping vigorous, gather red shields.
translations.idiomatic: Metal music rings clear and loud; stomping boldly they raise the red shields.

sentences.zh: 夾進昭威武，申嚴警宴安。

translations.literal: Flanking advance shows martial might; express strictness, warn against banquet ease.
translations.idiomatic: Flanking advances display martial might; strict orders warn against complacency at the feast.

sentences.zh: 守方推猛士，當用冒為冠。

translations.literal: Defending the frontier promotes fierce warriors; helm should serve as crown.
translations.idiomatic: Defending the frontier promotes fierce warriors; the helm should serve as their crown.

sentences.zh: 六變宣榭始觀兵，桓桓稱鼓行。

translations.literal: Six changes—Pavilion beginning views troops; vigorous vigorous called drum advance.
translations.idiomatic: Six changes: at the review terrace they first display the troops; bold and vigorous the drums advance.

sentences.zh: 一戎期大定，載纘議徂征。

translations.literal: One campaign—term great settlement; load continuation—discuss going forth.
translations.idiomatic: One campaign aims at great settlement; they take counsel for the expedition.

sentences.zh: 善政從師律，神功冀《武成》。

translations.literal: Good government follows army discipline; divine achievement hopes for 《Martial Completion》.
translations.idiomatic: Good government follows military discipline; divine achievement looks to 《Martial Completion》.

sentences.zh: 勖哉勤誓眾，王業自經營。

translations.literal: Exert yourselves—diligent oath to the masses; kingly enterprise by itself is managed.
translations.idiomatic: Exert yourselves and swear diligence to the hosts; the royal enterprise is built of itself.

sentences.zh: 聲教方柔遠，甌、閩禮可招。

translations.literal: Sound and teaching just now soften the distance; Ou and Min—rites can be summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Civilizing influence now softens distant lands; Ou and Min may be called by ritual.

sentences.zh: 獻圖連日際，歸國象江潮。

translations.literal: Presenting maps day after day at the border; returning states like Yangtze tides.
translations.idiomatic: They present maps day after day at the frontier; homeward states come like Yangtze tides.

sentences.zh: 撫運重熙盛，提封萬里遙。

translations.literal: Upholding fortune—double splendor flourishing; holding seal—ten thousand li distant.
translations.idiomatic: Upholding a glorious age of renewed prosperity; his rule extends ten thousand li.

sentences.zh: 還同有虞氏，文德格三苗。

translations.literal: Still the same as Yu's time; culture and virtue transform the Three Miao.
translations.idiomatic: As in the age of Yu, civil virtue transforms the Three Miao.

sentences.zh: 南暨宣皇化，東吳奉乃神。

translations.literal: South reaches—proclaim imperial transformation; eastern Wu serves this spirit.
translations.idiomatic: To the south they proclaim imperial transformation; eastern Wu serves this divine power.

sentences.zh: 舞幹方耀德，執玉自來賓。

translations.literal: Dance shields just now display virtue; holding jade—they come as guests.
translations.idiomatic: With shield-dances they now display virtue; bearing jade they come as guests.

sentences.zh: 巢伯朝丹陛，韓侯覲紫宸。

translations.literal: Chao Bo attends the crimson steps; Marquis Han views the purple court.
translations.idiomatic: Chao Bo attends the crimson steps; Marquis Han views the purple court.

sentences.zh: 古今歸一揆，懷遠道彌新。

translations.literal: Past and present return to one measure; cherishing the distant—Way ever new.
translations.idiomatic: Past and present return to one standard; cherishing the distant, the Way grows ever new.

sentences.zh: 遺俗續陶唐，來蘇徯聖皇。

translations.literal: Surviving customs continue Tao Tang; coming restoration awaits the sage emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Surviving customs continue the age of Yao and Shun; restoration awaits the sage emperor.

sentences.zh: 布昭湯吊伐，恢復漢封疆。

translations.literal: Spreading abroad—Tang's hanging campaigns of punitive attack; restoring Han's sealed borders.
translations.idiomatic: Proclaiming Tang's punitive campaigns; restoring the Han domain.

sentences.zh: 金鉞申戡剪，朱幹示發揚。

translations.literal: Golden battle-axes declare cutting down; red shields display raising and spreading.
translations.idiomatic: Golden axes proclaim the conquest; red shields display martial glory.

sentences.zh: 宜哉七德頌，千載播洋洋。

translations.literal: Fitting indeed—the seven virtues praised; thousand years broadcast vast vast.
translations.idiomatic: Fitting indeed are the seven virtues praised; for a thousand years they resound far and wide.

sentences.zh: 乃眷嘗西顧，偏師暫首征。

translations.literal: Thus cherishing—once gazed westward; partial army for a time first campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: Once he turned his gaze westward; a detached force for a time led the first campaign.

sentences.zh: 靈旗方直指，獷俗自亡精。

translations.literal: Spirit banners just now point straight; wild customs by themselves lose their essence.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit banners point straight ahead; barbarian ways lose their spirit of themselves.

sentences.zh: 禹敘終馴致，堯封漸化成。

translations.literal: Yu's ordering in the end tame and arriving; Yao's enfeoffment gradually transforms and completes.
translations.idiomatic: Yu's ordering at last brings submission; Yao's enfeoffment gradually brings transformation.

sentences.zh: 不須嚴尉候，於廓海彌清。

translations.literal: No need for strict frontier guards; in the vastness the sea grows ever clearer.
translations.idiomatic: No need for strict border watches; the seas grow ever clearer in the vast realm.

sentences.zh: 幹戚有司傳，威容著凱旋。

translations.literal: Shield and axe—the relevant office transmits; martial bearing displays triumphant return.
translations.idiomatic: Shield and battle-axe—the proper office announces; martial bearing marks the triumphal return.

sentences.zh: 象成王業盛，役輟武功全。

translations.literal: Elephant accomplished—kingly enterprise flourishing; corvée ceased—martial achievement complete.
translations.idiomatic: The elephant rite shows the royal work flourishing; labor service ceases as martial merit is complete.

sentences.zh: 兵寢西郊閱，書惟北闕縣。

translations.literal: Arms rest—western suburb review; writings only—northern gate displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Arms rest at the western suburb review; edicts hang only at the northern gate.

sentences.zh: 聖神膺景命，卜世萬斯年。

translations.literal: Sage and divine receive the bright mandate; divining the age—ten thousand such years.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred and divine, he receives the bright mandate; his reign is divined for ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 景德中朝會一十四首皇帝升坐，《隆安》金奏在庭，群後在位。

translations.literal: Jingde mid-court assembly fourteen pieces—emperor ascends to be seated—《Long'an》—metal performance in the courtyard, all the nobles in position.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen pieces for the Jingde mid-court assembly: when the emperor takes his seat—《Long'an》—metal music sounds in the hall; the nobles take their places.

translations.literal: Heaven's might brilliant brilliant; facing brightness, bearing the screen.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's might shines resplendent; facing the light he leans upon the screen.

translations.literal: High arching, reverent and clear; cap and robes properly draped.
translations.idiomatic: He sits elevated, grave and serene; cap and robes are properly arrayed.

translations.literal: Abundant virtue daily renewed; ritual bearing has splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant virtue renews day by day; ritual bearing shines with splendor.

sentences.zh: 公卿入門，《正安》萬邦來同，九賓在位。

translations.literal: Dukes and ministers enter the gate—《Zheng'an》—ten thousand states come together, nine guests in position.
translations.idiomatic: As ministers pass through the gate, 《Zheng'an》 plays: ten thousand states assemble; nine ranks of guests take their places.

translations.literal: Presenting jade tablets, recommending gentry; ascending and descending, stopping in the court.
translations.idiomatic: They present jade tablets and recommend the gentry; ascending and descending they halt in the court.

translations.literal: Literary thought peaceful peaceful; majestic bearing abundant abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Literary thought is serene; majestic bearing is stately.

translations.literal: Ministers indeed, neighbors indeed; aid your borderland blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers indeed, neighbors indeed—may you aid your frontier blessings.

sentences.zh: 上壽，《和安》天威煌煌，山龍采章。

translations.literal: Toast to longevity—《He'an》—heaven's might brilliant brilliant; mountain-dragon patterned robes.

translations.literal: Court treasures arrayed in hundreds; high dukes present the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: Court treasures stand in hundreds; the chief dukes present the goblet.

translations.literal: Bow and yield to all the nobles; properly draped, robes hang down.
translations.idiomatic: He bows to the assembled nobles; properly draped, his robes hang in order.

translations.literal: Forever bestowed—hard to grow old; ten thousand years without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Forever granted long life; ten thousand years without bound.

translations.literal: Emperor first raises wine—《Auspicious Unicorn》

translations.literal: Imperial design meets flourishing; two beasts present auspiciousness.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial design meets prosperity; two beasts present auspicious signs.

translations.literal: Accumulated thickness flows downward; sustaining life, abundant flourishing.

translations.literal: Paying court, moistening below; good benefit without bound.

translations.idiomatic: Blessing the sage, storing blessing; assisting and manifesting heaven's intent.
